markscheme.marking_summary: Exact original MS leaf excerpt: Award [2 max] A feedback system samples the output signals (temperature) then a sample (a fraction of the output signal) is fed back to the input; to change/modify the input signal; in such a way as to produce an output signal that differs substantially from the output signal produced in the absence of such feedback / as to increase or decrease the temperature in the house; The output value is (continuously) compared to the desired value to produce an error value/ difference/ adjusting factor; the error value/ difference/ adjusting factor is fed to input; to determine the next action/ to achieve a desired outcome/pre-set temperature in the room;
